display.purpose: The two-line personal name shares the opening grid with a real Victoria Harbour dusk photograph; the desktop size caps at 112px and responsive sizes are documented in DESIGN.md.

headline.purpose: Main section headings and the evidence-browser introduction.

title.purpose: Project topic headings in asymmetric editorial features.

lead.purpose: Detail-page introductory text; related research-theme and figure headings share the fluid size with their observed component styling.

body.purpose: Main narrative with a default 70ch maximum measure.

label.purpose: Dates, captions, resource links, authors, and navigation.

publication-title.purpose: A concise topic heading for scanning the scholarly record.

paper-title.purpose: Full scholarly title remains a visible paragraph below the publication topic.

research-title.purpose: The full manipulation-study heading, limited to 25ch.

positioning.purpose: The homepage positioning statement aligns above the introduction beneath Daniel, with a quieter size and relaxed heading tracking.

shadows.name: mobile-navigation-drawer
shadows.purpose: Structural separation beneath the anchored mobile navigation drawer at 850px and below; the dismissible backdrop is #1f2b4d24. Ordinary content surfaces remain flat.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Implemented easing for the bounded hero entrance, drawer, marker, native reading transition, disclosure body, photo hover, icons and action transforms.

motion.name: name-entrance
motion.value: 700ms; second-line delay 70ms; translateY(28%) and opacity .3 to 0 and 1
motion.purpose: Once on load for each personal-name line; the second line ends at 770ms. Skipped for reduced motion and cancelled when a native page reveal supplies continuity.

motion.name: hero-photo-entrance
motion.value: 680ms; delay 100ms; clip-path inset(0 0 18% 0), translateY(12px), opacity .6 to inset(0), 0, 1
motion.purpose: The Victoria Harbour photograph opens beside Daniel; this is the longest hero entrance at 780ms total. Content remains visible in the source.

motion.name: mobile-menu-open
motion.value: drawer 220ms from translateY(-10px) and opacity 0; backdrop 180ms fade
motion.purpose: Pointer opening of the anchored overlay without moving the document. Repeated toggles cancel prior animations; keyboard and reduced motion settle immediately.

motion.name: mobile-menu-close
motion.value: 100ms opacity fade for drawer and backdrop
motion.purpose: Faster pointer dismissal; closed controls become inert immediately. Escape, focus departure, link selection and keyboard activation settle directly.

motion.name: navigation-marker
motion.purpose: The single 6px orange marker travels to the current section link. Keyboard input moves it immediately.

motion.name: evidence-native-transition
motion.value: outgoing 100ms opacity fade; incoming 240ms from translateY(8px) and opacity 0
motion.purpose: Pointer-triggered native View Transition on the evidence browser. Rapid requests skip obsolete snapshots and apply the latest selection; keyboard and reduced motion are immediate.

motion.name: evidence-fallback
motion.purpose: Pointer-triggered new-panel settling when document.startViewTransition is unavailable; the selected state is applied before this optional animation.

motion.name: page-navigation
motion.value: outgoing 100ms opacity fade; incoming 220ms from translateY(8px) and opacity 0; rail animation none
motion.purpose: Progressive same-origin cross-document View Transitions preserve the identity rail. Unsupported browsers navigate normally; keyboard navigation and reduced motion skip the transition.

motion.name: disclosure-open
motion.purpose: Pointer opening settles newly visible native disclosure body content. Keyboard and reduced-motion openings are immediate.

motion.name: plus-rotation
motion.purpose: Menu and ordinary disclosure state feedback; keyboard input disables the CSS transition. Photograph credits omit the disclosure plus.

motion.name: hero-photo-hover
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer hover within the clipped photographic frame; reduced motion makes it effectively immediate.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button, filled-link, and CV-link press feedback.

motion.name: arrow-hover
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer hover on linked inline arrows.

motion.name: color-state
motion.purpose: Navigation color, filled-action surface, and evidence-control state changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: .01ms CSS animation/transition duration; scroll-behavior:auto; native View Transitions disabled; scripted motion skipped or cancelled
motion.purpose: Respects prefers-reduced-motion:reduce, including changes during an interaction. Content is visible by default; there are no repeated scroll reveals.

components.css: .ds-rail{padding:36px 24px;background:var(--ink,#1f2b4d);color:var(--paper,#fff);}.ds-nav{font-family:Chivo,Arial,sans-serif;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:4px;}.ds-nav a{position:relative;padding:8px 12px;color:var(--rail-secondary,#c8d3e8);font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;text-decoration:none;transition:color 180ms ease;}.ds-nav a[aria-current]{background:var(--paper,#fff);color:var(--ink,#1f2b4d);font-weight:700;}.ds-nav-indicator{position:absolute;inset:0 auto auto 0;width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--accent,#f7941d);pointer-events:none;transform:translate3d(-12px,16.2px,0);transition:transform 220ms var(--ease-out,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1));}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#f7941d);outline-offset:5px;}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-nav a:hover:not([aria-current]){color:var(--paper,#fff);background:var(--rail-hover,#34425f);}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a,.ds-nav-indicator{transition-duration:.01ms;}}

narrative.overview:
The portfolio uses personal names, generous Chivo typography, and real photographic and experimental material to introduce a researcher whose work can be examined closely. A navy portrait rail keeps identity and navigation available beside a calm reading column. White and pale blue chapter fields separate introduction, evidence, publications, and background; small orange marks identify interaction and emphasis.

This name describes the implemented code-led direction, rather than an independently approved visual metaphor or image comp. The system is extracted from styles.css, layout-motion.css, script.js, and the manipulation project's project.css. Its documented direction is associated with FORM seed:d1c603635fc5df31 in docs/design-plan.md; the opening composition and motion are refined in docs/hero-motion-refinement.md, with navigation and chapter contrast recorded in docs/section-contrast-refinement.md. No visual-comp fidelity or catalog quality-bar approval is asserted.
keyCharacteristics: Type-led identity with a self-hosted Chivo variable font.
A navy navigation ground, white and pale blue chapter fields, and restrained orange interaction marks.
Real Hong Kong, portrait, industrial, and scientific imagery.
Asymmetric editorial layouts rather than a repeated card grid.
Inspectable evidence, native disclosures, and manually controlled video.
One bounded hero entrance and short state transitions, with content visible by default and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Accent Restraint Rule
rules.body: Reserve orange for small orientation, selection, underline, and focus details; reading-column filled actions remain navy and the rail CV action reverses to paper.

rules.name: The Focus Contrast Rule
rules.body: Light surfaces use the navy focus outline; the navy rail, contact, and dark-project fields use the orange outline. Keep the visible outline outside the control rather than replacing it with a subtle color shift.

rules.name: The Two Titles Rule
rules.body: A short publication topic may aid scanning, but keep the original scholarly title visibly readable in the adjacent text block.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Scientific figures and ordinary content containers rely on a tonal surround and spacing; do not add decorative elevation to the evidence.

dos: **Do** use self-hosted Chivo and the documented size hierarchy, preserving readable body and metadata text.
**Do** use the fixed identity rail on desktop and the disclosed top navigation on small screens.
**Do** preserve navy focus outlines on light surfaces and orange outlines in the navy rail, dark project, and contact fields.
**Do** keep the navy navigation ground continuous across desktop rail, mobile header, and full-width drawer, with a paper current destination and reversed CV action.
**Do** separate reading chapters with the documented white and pale blue fields and equal top/bottom chapter padding.
**Do** pair every scientific figure, metric, and recording with its visible scope and caption.
**Do** retain original paper titles as visible paragraphs below concise publication topic headings.
**Do** preserve native video controls, manual playback, and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** use real portrait, Hong Kong, industrial, and scientific assets with their existing attribution and meaning.
donts: **Don't** expand orange into large decorative backgrounds or replace the navy primary action.
**Don't** turn the asymmetric project sequence into a repeated rounded-card grid.
**Don't** crop scientific evidence for a photographic effect or detach it from its experimental context.
**Don't** add gradients, decorative grids, 3D effects, synthetic evidence, or invented personal photographs.
**Don't** add routine card shadows; the existing shadow belongs to the anchored mobile navigation drawer.
**Don't** make essential text, navigation, or evidence depend on JavaScript or entrance motion.
